implement.approach: Gap on BASE f250acd7 (INFERRED from code): privacy.ts already formats release/dist/source_revision (diagnosticsRelease, minimizeJavaScriptEvent), but runtimeConfig.ts ships nativeBuildNumber=null and sourceRevision=null, nothing at build time produces an identity artifact, and sentry.ts diagnosticsGate()/initializeDiagnostics() (sentry.ts:44-70, :295-300 on BASE) only read runtimeConfig — so an approved build could never pass blocked_identity, and any populated value would have had to be hand-edited/mutable. Fix: (1) bundle-xcode.sh runs the protected, unmodified scripts/release-identity.mjs --check --require-committed --json (the same validator fastlane runs) and writes version/build/bundle/gitSha/committed to a git-ignored src/config/releaseIdentity.generated.json before Metro bundles; refusal or uncommitted tree leaves no file. (3) diagnosticsGate(config, generated) applies it AFTER transport/provider/disclosures/DSN/native-privacy gates and before diagnosticsIdentity(); initializeDiagnostics() passes generatedReleaseIdentity(). Existing optionsForDiagnostics/createErrorReporter/scrub paths untouched, so envelopes carry release=com.picklesensei@<version>+<build>, dist=<build>, tags.source_revision=<sha>, model/policy versions, and stay scrubbed.
